title: Two-on-One Advantage Reads
description: Two attackers push a break against a single retreating defender, learning to read whether to pass or finish based on the defender's chair position.

content.objective: Read the single defender's chair position to decide whether to pass or attack the rim directly.
content.setup: Two offensive players push against one retreating defender.
instructions: The ball handler attacks the middle with the second attacker spread wide.
The defender can only take away one option; the ball handler reads which.
Pass to the open side if the defender commits to the ball, or finish if the defender commits to the pass.
Push back to the baseline and run it back the other way.
coachingPoints: Keep real width between the two attackers so the defender can't cover both.
Make the read early, not at the last possible second.
Finish strong once the advantage is actually there.
commonMistakes: Both attackers pushing the same lane, erasing the advantage.
Forcing a pass when the lane to the rim was actually open.
Bunching into the same lane instead of spreading the floor.
content.safety: Make sure the full-court lane is clear of other groups before pushing at speed.
